changelog:
- Initial release of Xunlei Docker Downloader Skill.
- Submit and manage magnet link downloads via Docker-deployed Xunlei services.
- Monitor and view download task status, including progress and speed.
- Configure service host, port, and SSL options.
- NEW: Adds intelligent content filtering to prioritize main content over advertisements during submissions.
summary: Interact with Docker-deployed Xunlei to submit magnet links, monitor tasks, and prioritize main content downloads with intelligent filtering.
